tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: All other conditions as per tender document

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
bidder has to quote rates inclusive of all taxes, wastage, making charges, stone charges and other accessories

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All other documents as per tender document

Turnover certificate/Balance sheet/profit & loss statement/Income tax returns statements for last 5 years for atleast Rs. 9.00 Lakhs In any two of the last five Financial year i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 certified by Auditor.

itemList.itemName: Providing finished gold ornament of around 50gms. made out of BIS Hallmarked 22 carat gold with HUID (cost inclusive of all taxes, wastage, making charges, stone charges and other accessories.) Design as per the committee decision and direction of officer in charge.
